title: Visual Anything package file
description: The contents of a `.vapackage` file: components and relation types from one domain, shared as a unit.

images.description: The images its components' appearances, and elements' own appearances, show. Each is data only: nothing in it runs or refers to anything outside it. Left out when there are none.

Id.description: An identifier, generated once and never reused. Files refer to each other only by id. Element and relation ids share one namespace, because a relation can end on either. Component and relation type ids start with their package's id, as in `systems.service`.

derivesFrom.description: The component this one derives from: another component, or `essence`.

attributes.description: The attributes this component adds to the ones it inherits.

Component.description: The reusable definition of a kind of element. It inherits everything it does not redefine.

default.description: The value an element or relation has when it does not set its own.

choices.description: For a string attribute, the values it is expected to take, offered in this order. Any other value only produces a warning.

unit.description: For a number attribute, the unit its values are in, written after them on shapes, such as "ms" or "GB".

AttributeDefinition.description: An attribute that a component or relation type defines.

shape.description: The kind of its shapes. While its shapes draw their contents as rows, any kind other than `rounded-rectangle` is drawn as a rectangle.

width.description: The width of its shapes when a view does not set one, in canvas units.

height.description: The height of its shapes when a view does not set one, in canvas units. Shapes that draw their contents as rows take their height from their rows instead.

detail.description: What its shapes write under the element's name. Each part is inherited on its own.

contentsAsRows.description: Whether its shapes draw the elements they hold as rows: one under another below a header, as wide as the shape, in the model's order, as a table draws its columns. Rows have no positions of their own in views, and the shape's height follows its rows.

connectionPoints.description: Where relations attach to its shapes: each relation attaches to the one facing its other end. An empty list has relations attach anywhere on the border, whatever is inherited. Shapes that draw their contents as rows attach relations beside their header and their rows instead.

image.description: The image its shapes show; `none` shows none, whatever is inherited.

Appearance.description: How an element's shapes are drawn. Whatever an appearance leaves out is inherited.

Color.description: A color written as `#RRGGBB`: no alpha, no short form and no names. Files may write the digits in either case; the program writes new colors in capitals and keeps a color's spelling when it is set to the same color again.

componentName.description: Whether it writes the component's name. Essence writes it.

attributes.description: The attributes whose values it writes, in this order, after the component's name; an attribute without a value is skipped.

badges.description: The badges it writes after the values, each while its element meets the badge's condition.

DetailRules.description: What a shape writes under its element's name, on one line.

Badge.description: A short text, such as "PK", that a shape writes while its element meets the badge's condition.

attribute.description: The name of a boolean attribute of the element.

AttributeBadge.description: A badge written while a boolean attribute of the element is true.

RelationEndBadge.description: A badge written while the element is the `from` end of a relation of this relation type, or of one derived from it.

name.description: Unique among the connection points of one appearance, such as "in" or "out".

at.description: Where it sits along its side, from 0 at the side's left or top end to 1 at its right or bottom end.

ConnectionPoint.description: A named place on the border of a shape where relations attach.

image.description: The id of an image that a package in use defines.

placement.description: `icon`, the default: small, beside the name, inside the shape. `drawing`: on a plate in place of the shape, with the name under it. Shapes that hold other shapes or draw rows always show it as an icon in their header, and rows as a small icon before their name.

tint.description: When set, the picture is drawn as a silhouette of this colour: its shape kept, its colours replaced.

derivesFrom.description: The relation type this one derives from: another relation type, or `relates-to`.

nests.description: Whether its relations place their `from` element inside their `to` element, as "is part of" does.

attributes.description: The attributes this relation type adds to the ones it inherits.

limits.description: What its relations may connect. Breaking a limit only produces a warning.

RelationType.description: The reusable definition of a kind of relation. It inherits everything it does not redefine.

width.description: The line width, in canvas units.

RelationTypeLimits.description: What the ends of a relation type's relations may be. A list left out is inherited from the relation type this one derives from, and sets no limit when none sets one; `any` sets no limit on that end, whatever is inherited. Breaking a limit only produces a warning.

LimitList.description: The ids of the components or relation types an end may be created from. An end created from one of them, or from anything derived from one of them, keeps within the limit.

ImageDefinition.description: A picture a package defines, kept as the core cleaned it.

id.description: Starts with its package's id, as in `clinic.whatsapp-logo-k3f9q2`.

source.description: Where it comes from and under which licence, such as "Simple Icons, CC0-1.0".

width.description: The width of its view box, which with its height gives its proportions.

height.description: The height of its view box.

svg.description: Its SVG text as the core cleans it: one `svg` element with a `viewBox`, elements and attributes from an allow-list only, and references only to its own parts.

SvgImage.description: A picture drawn from SVG: shapes, paths, gradients, clipping and masks only.

id.description: Starts with its package's id, as in `clinic.front-desk-4fj2ka`.

source.description: Where it comes from and under which licence.

width.description: Its width in pixels, as its header gives it.

height.description: Its height in pixels, as its header gives it.

BitmapImage.description: A picture kept as the bytes of a PNG, JPEG or WebP file, without its metadata.
